# HRVICO — Intelligent HRMS & Payroll Automation Platform

> HRVICO (developed by Scriza) is an all-in-one Human Resource Management System (HRMS) built for Indian startups, SMEs, and growing enterprises. It automates statutory payroll (EPF, ESIC, PT, TDS), attendance tracking (geo-fencing, biometrics, facial recognition), leave approvals, performance appraisals (OKRs/KPIs), and employee lifecycle workflows.

## Statutory Compliance Supported (India)
1. **Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)**: Auto-calculation of employee (12%) and employer (12%) contributions, generation of ECR file for direct EPFO portal upload.
2. **Employee State Insurance (ESIC)**: Automatic wage ceiling monitoring (₹21,000 threshold), deduction of 0.75% employee and 3.25% employer contributions.
3. **Professional Tax (PT)**: State-wise automated slabs for Maharashtra, Karnataka, West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Gujarat.
4. **Income Tax & TDS (Section 192)**: New and Old tax regime comparison, investment declaration verification (80C, 80D, HRA), Form 16 Part A & B generation.
5. **Gratuity & Bonus Acts**: Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 calculation and Payment of Bonus Act 1965 tracking.
